title: Module 13 Challenge
summary: A student project for the ASU AI Bootcamp that builds logistic regression and random forest classifiers to detect spam emails for an ISP. The only connection to SDV is an unrelated string 'sdv' embedded in a filesystem path within a conda-generated requirements.txt dependency line, with no actual SDV package usage.
needs: The 'sdv' substring is part of a random temp folder name in a conda build path, not a reference to the Synthetic Data Vault library.
